## berth system upgrade

install a verified release and switch to it (the previous one stays; restarts nothing)

### Synopsis

install a verified release and switch to it (the previous one stays; restarts nothing)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_system_upgrade/

```
berth system upgrade [--version vX.Y.Z] | --rollback [flags]
```

### Examples

```

  berth system upgrade --version v0.4.0
  berth system upgrade --rollback
```
